rules.path_body_equality: Every campaign_id, revision_id, record_id, proposal_id, and proposal_version present in a path and body must match exactly before lookup, replay, or mutation.
rules.public_identifiers: Public IDs are opaque domain identifiers, never paths, SQL identifiers, handles, URLs, or provider values. Slash, backslash, traversal segments, absolute paths, and path-like identifiers fail closed.
rules.structured_documents: Candidates and cards use closed typed metadata, fields, sections, connections, references, and resolutions. Raw Markdown, reverse backlinks, edge IDs, paths, and database identifiers are not inputs.
rules.base_binding: Every mutation binds one exact revision object and the exact affected record digest; create uses null because its record is absent. A changed revision, tree digest, or record digest conflicts and never merges implicitly.
rules.editor_workflow_cas: One campaign-wide editor workflow counter is compared on every accepted mutation and incremented once; exact replay returns its stored result without incrementing.
rules.editor_workflow_lifecycle: If the current counter is N, an accepted create, edit, remove, or correction uses N and returns a proposal stamped N+1. Approval or rejection of that exact proposal uses N+1 and completes at N+2. Stale, invalid, and replayed operations do not increment the counter.
rules.operation_digest: payload_digest is lowercase SHA-256 over canonical UTF-8 JSON of the request body excluding contract_name, contract_version, operation_request, request_id, idempotency_key, and payload_digest. Keys are sorted, whitespace omitted, and array order preserved.
rules.canonical_content_digests: Record, impact, diff, proposal, and text digests use their named canonical objects; text normalizes CRLF and CR to LF without trimming.
rules.record_member_ids: Every record document rejects duplicate field_id, section_id, and connection_id values even when the complete objects differ.
rules.replay: Safe identifiers, equality bindings, canonical digest, and stored receipt are checked before workflow or revision comparison. Same key and digest replays exactly; changed payload conflicts without mutation.
rules.proposal_compatibility: core_proposal is authoritative canon_proposal v2. It preserves the v1 fields and authority/error meanings while accepting existing hyphenated Atlas/domain IDs directly; no legacy mapping exists.
rules.proposal_immutability: A correction creates a new immutable version. Rejection, conflict, and history preserve prior versions; no route edits one.
rules.authority_visibility: Authority and visibility transitions must appear in the exact cards and corresponding outcome arrays and require explicit confirmed IDs. Approval alone never promotes or widens.
rules.mutation_consistency: Card record digests, property changes, connection cards, derived backlink effects, authority and visibility entries, affected_record_count, and approval confirmation sets must be exact projections of the same mutation.
rules.connections: Only typed outgoing connections are submitted. Incoming backlinks are server-derived. Redirect targets must be selected existing domain IDs and may not be the removed record.
rules.removal: Every removal proposal, correction, rejection, and approval carries the exact impact binding and impact_digest. Every required typed reference has exactly one remove, redirect, or validator-permitted accept-unresolved resolution. No cascade or history deletion occurs.
rules.publication_binding: Draft, NeedsReview, rejected, and conflict proposals are not_published with no published revision; approving may be quarantined or not_published with no revision; only approved proposals are published and carry a published revision.
rules.historical_read_only: A historical view is always non-editable and only offers navigation to the current head.
rules.approval: Approval binds the exact proposal ID and version, source/base/current-head revisions, workflow counter, record bindings, payload/diff and validation digests, impact digest, authority and visibility outcomes, affected count, transition IDs, and true Warden confirmation. The loaded proposal must be needs_review and validation must be passed with zero errors before the existing revision compare-and-swap boundary is reached.
rules.rejection: Rejection is explicit from Draft or NeedsReview. It binds the exact proposal ID and version, source/base/current-head revisions, workflow counter, record bindings, payload/diff and validation digests, impact digest, authority and visibility outcomes, and true Warden confirmation. A changed current head, workflow counter, or loaded proposal field fails closed. A stale head maps to HTTP 409 stale_revision.
rules.fail_closed: Binding, validation, replay, conflict, and publication failures use the active HTTP v2 error_response envelope and leave the current head and prior revisions unchanged.
